slides.title: Manager's Daily Work
slides.takeaway: Like a chef, they need tools
slides.notes: District managers work like chefs. They need tools to prepare reports efficiently. Local AI is a new tool that helps them work faster and smarter, just as a chef needs knives and appliances.

slides.title: Work in the Store
slides.notes: District managers spend 30 minutes per store writing reports. These reports reference confidential data and are often written offline. About 25% of stores have unreliable Wi-Fi, making cloud tools harder to use.

slides.title: Local AI Architecture
slides.takeaway: AI runs on device, not in the cloud
slides.notes: Local AI runs directly on the Surface Ultra with NVIDIA RTX Spark. The device uses Gemma 4 26B for processing, and all data stays local to the device. This ensures privacy while enabling fast performance.

slides.title: Cloud vs Local AI
slides.takeaway: Local AI works offline, keeps data secure

data.verdict: Local AI is better for store work

slides.notes: Cloud AI needs internet and sends data to the cloud. Local AI runs on the device, works offline, and keeps sensitive data secure. For district managers in stores, local AI is a better fit.

slides.title: Pilot Plan
slides.notes: The pilot will run for 3 weeks with 8 district managers. It includes setup, data collection, and a final review. The goal is to measure report time, quality, and user experience.

slides.title: Device Capacity
slides.notes: The Surface Ultra has 128 GB of memory, 20 CPU cores, and an NVIDIA RTX Spark GPU. This makes it powerful enough to run local AI models like Gemma 4 26B efficiently.

slides.title: Hybrid AI Approach

data.text: Local AI adds a second lane to Microsoft 365 Copilot

slides.notes: Local AI doesn't replace Microsoft 365 Copilot. Instead, it adds another lane for sensitive, repeated tasks like report writing. Both tools work together.

slides.title: Time Savings Estimate
slides.notes: If local AI saves 10 minutes per report, and there are 60 managers writing 12 reports a week for 48 weeks, that's an estimated 5,760 hours saved. This is illustrative and will be validated in the pilot.

slides.title: Next Steps

data.ask: Approve the 3-week pilot with 8 district managers

slides.notes: We ask for approval to launch a 3-week pilot with 8 district managers. This will validate time savings, data security, and user experience before wider rollout.
